module.name: theorem
module.description: A numbered theorem / lemma / definition / corollary box with a coloured accent. Body = the statement (Markdown + math).
module.aiSpec:
A THEOREM-style environment for maths/CS slides — a labelled, numbered, accented box holding a statement. Block module: the body is the statement (Markdown, and inline \(math\) / display \[math\] both render). Params: `kind` — one of theorem, lemma, definition, corollary, proposition, example, remark (default theorem; theorem-like kinds set the body italic, definition/example/remark stay upright) — OR the heading word itself in another language: 定理, 命題, 補題, 定義, 系, 例, 注意 … (shown as written, the body upright, the header "命題 A（名前）" with no period); `number` — free text like 1, 2.3 or A (default empty = unnumbered); `title` — optional name shown in parentheses; `color` — accent colour (default var(--accent-color)); `italic` — auto | true | false (auto = italic for the English theorem-like kinds only); `head` — auto | inline | block (auto = the header runs into the statement, or stands on its own line when the statement starts with a list, a display formula or a table); `variant` — bar (accent bar and tint, default) | outline (a thin frame) | plain (no box). Header reads e.g. "Theorem 2 (Pythagoras)."
<!-- @theorem kind: theorem, number: 1, title: Pythagoras --> For a right triangle, \(a^2 + b^2 = c^2\). <!-- @end -->
<!-- @theorem kind: 命題, number: A, title: 解の一意性, variant: outline --> - \(f\) はリプシッツ連続 - このとき，初期値問題の解はただ 1 つ <!-- @end -->

param.name: kind
param.label: Kind
param.options: theorem:Theorem,lemma:Lemma,definition:Definition,corollary:Corollary,proposition:Proposition,example:Example,remark:Remark,定理:定理,命題:命題,補題:補題,定義:定義,系:系,例:例,注意:注意
param.desc: Environment name shown in the header; English theorem-like kinds render the body in italics, a Japanese kind is shown as written.

param.name: number
param.label: Number
param.desc: Free-form number such as 1 or 2.3 (empty = unnumbered).

param.name: title
param.label: Title (optional)
param.desc: Optional name shown in parentheses after the number, e.g. Pythagoras.

param.name: color
param.label: Accent color
param.desc: Colour of the left border, header text and box tint.

param.name: italic
param.label: Italic statement
param.desc: Whether the statement is set in italics.

param.name: head
param.label: Header
param.options: auto:Auto,inline:Runs into the statement,block:On its own line
param.desc: Where the header goes (auto: its own line when the statement starts with a list, a display formula or a table).

param.name: variant
param.label: Box
param.options: bar:Accent bar and tint,outline:Thin frame,plain:No box

snippet.label: Theorem box
snippet.text: <!-- @theorem kind: theorem, number: 1, title: Pythagoras --> For a right triangle with legs \(a, b\) and hypotenuse \(c\), \[ a^2 + b^2 = c^2. \] <!-- @end -->
snippet.description: Numbered theorem/lemma/definition box; body is the statement (math renders).
